title: Route request: prime gaps H1 <= 246 (AxiomMath + kimihiro64)
body:
ASK-FIRST route request — not a Lean submission. I have not opened a statement PR and will not use any submit tool until a maintainer opens the route and confirms the statement form.

## Result

Prime gaps are bounded by **246** infinitely often (`H1 ≤ 246`), verified in Lean 4.

## Repo & commit

- https://github.com/darkhipo/prime-gaps-246-lean
- commit `ac0eb01b6617f5b3bd978037bff937488ad34e73` (branch `main`)

## What it composes

- **AxiomMath/PrimeGapsLib** @ `1faa7b1` — proves `bombieriVinogradov_implies_prime_gap_le_246` with a Lean-checked 50-tuple certificate.
- **kimihiro64/bombieri-vinogradov** @ `7a17483` (Jonas Whidden) — proves the full Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem.

`Submission.lean` feeds BV's theorem into PrimeGapsLib's implication, producing three hypothesis-free statements: `prime_gap_le_246`, `frequently_prime_gap_le_246` (liminf form), and `nth_prime_gap_le_246`.

## Build (clean, no stale oleans)

```
lake build Submission
# Build completed successfully (5437 jobs).  BUILD EXIT=0
```

## Pins

- Lean `v4.33.1`
- mathlib `0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474`
- PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (kimihiro64) `0f15a38c619298b5cd786d39a84dd4bb8997324c`

## Question

This target needs a maintainer-owned trusted statement/profile: the exact "H1 ≤ 246" statement form is not something I can self-declare. Will you open this route? And which existing pin/statement form do you prefer — the elementary `∀ n₀ ∃ p q, n₀ ≤ p ∧ p < q ∧ p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ q ≤ p + 246`, the liminf/frequently form, or a specific profile? I'll hold any statement PR until a maintainer asks.
